blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: A trace table records variable values after each meaningful execution step: i, a[i], condition and result.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: A boundary test probes just below, at and above a threshold. Normal, erroneous and exceptional tests reveal different faults.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Test early success, late success, absent target, and empty arrays. For this function, −1 distinguishes not found from index0.
